title: OceanBase external-table plugin: load_schema output document

columns.description: Table columns, in read order. Non-empty.

partition_keys.description: Names of partition columns (option B: mark only; OB builds no partitions, partition pruning is the plugin's job via the predicate JSON at plan_create). Absent/empty = no partition columns.

catalog_context.description: Opaque plugin-defined object (T0 versioning/pinning state, e.g. snapshot/schema ids). OB stores it verbatim, hands it back inside options_json at plan_create, and never looks inside. The contract defines NO keys here — the content is 100% plugin-private.

name.description: Column name. Non-empty; unique across columns. The predicate JSON's col nodes reference columns by this name.

field_id.description: Stable field id of the column (0..32750; unique across columns). OB derives its column_id as field_id + 16 and echoes it back as col_idx in the predicate/projection JSON. Keep ids stable across schema refreshes — catalog_context drift detection relies on it.

ext_type.description: Protocol type name (OB matches case-insensitively; emit UPPER). Names are the shared vocabulary in ob_external_table_plugin.h. NOT accepted for top-level columns today (OB returns OB_NOT_SUPPORTED): NULL, BINARY, VARBINARY, MAP, UNKNOWN — do not emit them; fail load_schema yourself if your format has a type outside this list.

children.description: ARRAY element descriptor: exactly one entry, recursive. Required iff ext_type == ARRAY. The element object only needs 'ext_type' (+precision/scale/length as its type requires, +its own children for nested ARRAY); name/field_id are ignored by OB here.

then.description: DECIMAL: precision and scale come as a pair — both -1/absent (OB default) or both >= 0.
precision = sub-second digits (fsp). Values above 6 are accepted but clamped to 6 with a WARN — emit <= 6. DATETIME = timezone-agnostic local time; TIMESTAMP = instant (LTZ semantics).

column_element.description: ARRAY element (recursive). Only ext_type is required. LOB types are auto-substituted by OB: STRING -> VARCHAR(65535), BINARY/VARBINARY -> VARBINARY(65535) — you may emit them, OB bounds them. MAP/NULL/UNKNOWN are rejected.

then.description: DECIMAL as array element REQUIRES precision and scale (>= 0) — unlike top-level, there is no default.
